_doc: Fixed interface for the 2026-10-23 ears (two INMP441 I2S mics) and mouth speaker change. Robot/guide world frame, mm, x forward, y left, z up, head at HOME. Source: free-space and ray checks in the session scratchpad (mic/), against print/world/*.stl (D-022 saddle layout: A7Z out of the head, U20 camera).

port_holes.part: head_bottom (lower head shell, Yellow, V1.30 geometry = print/world/head_bottom.stl)
port_holes.purpose: the speaker's sound leaves the head into the mouth: the lower jaw top (z 108.1-108.2) sits 0.3 mm under every hole with the beak closed, so the sound comes out when the beak opens
port_holes.verified: rays at each centre and +-1.25 mm: floor 111.2-111.3 to 108.5 (plain 2.8 mm plate), jaw top 108.1-108.2 directly below

speaker_box.part: new print (White), holds the speaker (28-30 x 20 x 4 mm) standing on its short edge, face +x
speaker_box.rests_on: jaw_support plate top (z 113.2) for x < 52.3, yellow floor (z 111.3) for x 52.3..58.5

duct.note: open-bottom channel on the yellow floor, ends over the six port holes; camera bottom z 115.1

speaker_box.fixing: 1 mm foam double-sided tape (box base to floor and plate; speaker face to the box front window), as D-008

ears.part: head_cap (White), option A: mid height just behind the face

left.note: inner wall point and normal found by ray in build

ears.board: INMP441 round module dia 13.4 (vendor photo, AITRIP B0972XP1YS), port on the label side at the centre, wires soldered directly (no header)
